captions_note: the big lines are the effect. The small plate is its own captions for a reel with none: with the reel's captions on, build with CAPTIONS=0 and keep them
in_a_reel: this is the reel's opening line: start the slot on the first word, end it on the cut after the line
write the lines in the CLIP block in the order said, the speaker's own words, capitals for SERIF and STACK
the buyer's style wins: set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's fonts and colours before the first build (effects/INDEX.md, Restyling an effect's own words)
steps: edit SERIF, STACK and ITALIC in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints the sizes, the times and the snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
